nodes.name: server-lifecycle-improvements openspec manifest
nodes.summary: Minimal spec-driven manifest for the VS Code extension server lifecycle improvement change, recording the creation date of 2026-07-16. Serves as the machine-readable anchor for this archive change set.

nodes.name: server-lifecycle-improvements design
nodes.summary: Design decisions for cross-platform server lifecycle management in the VS Code extension. Specifies OS-specific port discovery and termination (netstat+taskkill on Windows, lsof/fuser+kill on Unix), version verification via /health endpoint comparison against extension package version, and dynamic port extraction from apiUrl. Covers risks of terminating non-HipCortex processes and restricted execution environments.

nodes.name: server-lifecycle-improvements proposal
nodes.summary: Change proposal identifying orphaned server processes after VS Code extension reloads as the root cause of port conflicts, version drift, and startup failures. Proposes version-aware autostart, cross-platform port conflict resolution, dynamic port selection from apiUrl, and graceful cleanup on deactivation. Introduces the server-lifecycle capability affecting vscode-extension/src/extension.ts.

nodes.name: server-lifecycle-improvements tasks
nodes.summary: Fully checked-off task list covering four sections: dynamic port extraction and cross-platform killProcessOnPort utility, version-checking and port-killing in doAutoStartServer, deactivate() cleanup of globalServerProcess, and TypeScript compilation plus extension unit test and package verification.
